auto_fix.title: Ruling path routes on a mutable issue_type: retype any task to decision and it closes with no probe legs
auto_fix.fix: Route on the type the bead was created with, not its live type: read the `created` event / first-seen issue_type (or the HEAD ledger row) and refuse the ruling path when issue_type changed after creation. Belt and braces: have bead-capture-guard block `br update ... -t/--type decision` (and have check 35 flag a staged issue_type transition to decision as RED).

auto_fix.title: DECISION matcher is per-line over every comment: an unfilled template placeholder on line 2 of a memo closes a human-gate card
auto_fix.fix: Match only a comment whose FIRST line (the whole text, after trim) starts with `DECISION (`. Evaluate per comment with jq (`.[] | .text | split("\n")[0] | test("^\\s*DECISION \\([^)<>]+\\):")`). Reject placeholder actors (`<...>`) and placeholder bodies (`<choice>`). Add a test with a multi-line memo that quotes the idiom.

auto_fix.title: Check 35 rule 6 accepts any pre-existing or hand-written GATE:/FRESH-VERIFY:/TRIAGE-CLOSE: prefix as the landing record
auto_fix.fix: Judge only the comments new in this commit (reuse the new_comments slice). Require the close-gate grammar: `^(GATE: (receipt|decided) — <id> —|FRESH-VERIFY: <id> —|TRIAGE-CLOSE: <id> —)`, with the row's own id. Require created_at >= closed_at. Add fixtures for the stale-record reopen case and a bare `GATE:` string.

auto_fix.title: RECORD-FAILED reuses exit 1 ('bead stays open') on a bead that is already closed; the caller's retry is refused OWNERSHIP, so check 35 rule 6 can never go green
auto_fix.fix: Give RECORD-FAILED its own exit code (e.g. 3) and add it to the header's exit table. Add a record-only re-entry: when the bead is already `closed` and carries no landing-record prefix, close-gate.sh <id> --record-only writes the record and exits 0. Add a worker.md line for the new code ('the close landed; re-run with --record-only, never unclaim'). Add a close-gate.test.sh case that makes `comments add` fail and asserts the exit code and the recovery.

auto_fix.title: The ruling path accepts an indented draft `DECISION (…):` line anywhere inside any comment, including conductor notes that say no ruling exists
auto_fix.fix: Match comment-level, not line-level: `jq -r '.[] | .text' | ` → `jq -r '[.[] | select(.text | test("^DECISION \\([^)]*\\):"))] | last | .text // empty'`. The comment must BEGIN with `DECISION (`, with no leading whitespace. Take the newest such comment as the ruling. Add a close-gate.test.sh refusal case whose only DECISION text is an indented line inside a longer note.

auto_fix.title: The docket's one close idiom routes every human-gate bead to close-gate.sh, but only `decision`-typed beads have a path through it; the rest of the docket gets NOT-CHECKED
auto_fix.fix: Route the ruling path on the docket's own key: label `human-gate`/`pipeline-proposal`/`dream-proposal` OR `issue_type == decision`, in one predicate that the docket collector and the gate share. Alternatively, keep type routing but make the docket idiom refuse up front (retype to `decision` first) and say so in action-loop.md. Either way, add a close-gate.test.sh case for a `task`-typed human-gate bead with a recorded ruling.

auto_fix.title: The org-wide docket sweep sources br-call.sh from `$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/skills/…`, which does not exist at the org root or in most apps, so every repo renders DEGRADED
auto_fix.fix: Resolve helpers the way close-gate.sh resolves its own (relative to the script or skill being executed, or `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}`/.claude/skills fallback), not to the caller's git toplevel. Abort the sweep with one NOT-CHECKED line when `type br_call` fails, never N DEGRADED lines. In action-loop.md, chain the ledger commit on the gate's exit 0 so a missing or refusing gate cannot be followed by a 'ruling' commit.

auto_fix.title: Scan A's fenced read, the 'one read shape', drops `--json` and skips its own row-shape idiom; a second raw read survives in the same file
auto_fix.fix: Make the fence the idiom itself: `br_call list --limit 0 --json | jq -e '<idiom>'` and `br_call ready --limit 0 --json | jq -e '<idiom>'`. Route :199 through br_call plus the idiom. Either move the edge read into the fence as a named exception with its reason, or replace it with `br_call show --json` dependencies. Add a lint/grep probe that a `br_call (list|ready)` line in board-scan.md carries `--json`.

auto_fix.title: Check 35 rule 6 is red on this batch's own ledger commit; it landed only because no commit-time loop runs the rule
auto_fix.fix: Put rule 6 on a real commit-time path: have coordinator.sh (or swarm-commit.sh's ledger leg) run lint/checks/35-board-integrity.py against the staged ledger before it commits, or install the hooks.d chain in this checkout. Add a cutover guard, like rule 3's origin cutover, so closes with closed_at before the rule's landing are never judged. Backfill a note on ac-4y7l.4/.11/.12/.13, or record that they closed pre-rule.

auto_fix.title: RECORD-FAILED exits 1 after the close has landed, colliding with CLOSE-REFUSED's 'bead stays open' contract
auto_fix.fix: Write the landing record atomically: `"$BR" close "$BEAD" --reason "$REASON" --transition-comment "$LND_TEXT"`, with LND_TEXT computed before the close. If the two-step write is kept, give RECORD-FAILED its own exit code (for example 3), document it in the header, and add a worker.md §7/§8 arm: 'closed; re-add the record with br comments add, never re-run the gate'.

auto_fix.title: Org-wide docket sweep sources br-call.sh from the cwd repo's skills/, so from ~/mission or 3 of 4 apps every repo renders DEGRADED
auto_fix.fix: Resolve the helper from the skill's own install, never from the cwd repo. For example, `. "$HOME/mission/software/agent-compounds/skills/_tools/br-call.sh"`, or the `.claude/skills/_tools/br-call.sh` symlink every deploy target carries (verified present in all apps). Refuse once, loudly, if sourcing fails, instead of degrading per repo. Use the same resolvable path for close-gate.sh in action-loop.md and human-gate-template.md.

auto_fix.title: RECORD-FAILED exit (ac-4y7l.5) has no covering case: deleting both `exit 1`s leaves close-gate.test.sh green
auto_fix.fix: Add a mock switch such as AC2_TEST_BR_COMMENT_FAIL=1 that makes `comments add` exit 1. Add two cases, one on the ordinary receipt close and one on the decision ruling close. Each should assert rc=1, 'RECORD-FAILED' on stderr, and status=closed (the close landed and the record did not).

auto_fix.title: Rule 6 accepts FRESH-VERIFY: and TRIAGE-CLOSE: records, but only GATE: is ever fixtured; dropping both prefixes stays green
auto_fix.fix: Add two GREEN staged-lane fixtures, each a bead newly closed this commit: one with only a `FRESH-VERIFY: ...` comment and one with only a `TRIAGE-CLOSE: ...` comment. Assert rc=0 for each. Use the text shape close-gate.sh emits, not invented strings.

auto_fix.title: RECORD-FAILED exits 1 after the close has landed, but exit 1 is documented as 'the bead stays open', and refly.sh reopens on it
auto_fix.fix: Give RECORD-FAILED its own exit code (for example 3) in both arms. Document it in the header's Exit block and in worker.md §4b and §7 as 'closed, record missing: write the landing comment by hand, never re-run the gate, never unclaim'. Make refly.sh treat that code as closed and not reopen. Add close-gate.test.sh cases where the stub br fails `comments add` on the ordinary path and on the ruling path: expect the new code, status closed and the RECORD-FAILED token. Add one case that asserts 'GATE: receipt' lands on an ordinary receipt-backed close.

auto_fix.title: Rule 6's 'the ledger commit itself is the gate' is not wired: the installed pre-commit is gitleaks-only, and a460628 landed four unrecorded closes that check 35 flags RED
auto_fix.fix: Restore a pre-commit dispatcher that runs hooks.d/pre-commit/* (harness-sync.sh should own and verify it, and chain gitleaks as an entry rather than a replacement). Add a sensor, such as a lint check or a harness-sync --check leg, that goes RED when .git/hooks/pre-commit does not dispatch 60-ac-lint. Change rule 6's message to name a recovery that works on a closed bead, for example `br comments add <id> "GATE: receipt — <id> — backfilled: <evidence>"`. Repair the four beads.

auto_fix.title: The ruling-tap idiom sends every human-gate bead through close-gate.sh, but only issue_type=decision takes the ruling path, so task/bug/feature gate beads cannot be closed by the documented tap
auto_fix.fix: Route on the ruling rather than on issue_type: take the ruling path for any bead carrying `human-gate`, `pipeline-proposal` or `dream-proposal` with a DECISION comment, or for type decision. Resolve the gate path the way close-gate resolves its evidence core (`.claude/skills/...` fallback), or spell it via `$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/skills/ac-implement/scripts/close-gate.sh`. Add close-gate.test.sh cases: a `-t task` + human-gate bead with a DECISION comment closes with GATE: decided, and one without a DECISION comment gives CLOSE-REFUSED DECISION.

auto_fix.title: The org-wide sweep sources br-call.sh from <toplevel>/skills/_tools, which does not exist at org level or in unsit/art-still, so every repo renders a false DEGRADED
auto_fix.fix: Resolve the helper from the skill's own install location (for example `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR:-$HOME/mission/software/agent-compounds/skills}/_tools/br-call.sh`, or try `skills/_tools` then `.claude/skills/_tools`) and abort with a single `NOT-CHECKED: br-call.sh not found` if `type br_call` fails, never DEGRADED per repo. Print `unpushed ledger ($(basename "$repo")): N`.

auto_fix.title: Ruling path ignores the human-gate label: the agent-self-decision token `DECISION (agent)` closes cards only Craig may close
auto_fix.fix: When the bead carries `human-gate`, refuse a ruling whose actor is `agent`, `ac-*`, or any non-human token (an allowlist of human actors, or at least a denylist of the agent tokens doctrine defines). Keep `DECISION (ac-tidy)` accepted only for `pipeline-proposal` moot closes.

auto_fix.title: Rule 6 fires only on status 'closed': retiring work via tombstone (br delete) escapes the landing-record requirement
auto_fix.fix: Treat any staged transition into a terminal status ({closed, tombstone}) from a non-terminal HEAD status as a close that needs a landing record. For tombstone, a different record token (for example `DELETED:` with a reason) is enough, but the transition must not be silent.

auto_fix.title: tidy's app-board close/receipt/status counts, plan A1's only sensor where check 35 cannot run, exist as a label with no implementation
auto_fix.fix: Reuse the one implementation. Give lint/checks/35-board-integrity.py a `--board <path> --since <date> --count` mode that applies rules 4-6 to rows updated since the date and prints the three counts, then have tidy § 5 call it. If that is out of scope, fence the three jq lines in SKILL.md with the canon set and prefixes cited from check 35 by pointer.

auto_fix.title: Scan A's two fenced reads dropped --json but still promise an {issues:[...]} object and a flat array
auto_fix.fix: Make Scan A `br_call list --limit 0 --json | <idiom>` and `br_call ready --json | <idiom>`, and add the one sourcing line (with the .claude/skills fallback) above it.

auto_fix.fix: Inline the three jq predicates next to line 67, mirroring check 35's STATUS_CANON set, WORKER_RE first-line match and the GATE:/FRESH-VERIFY:/TRIAGE-CLOSE: prefix set, with the since-date read from last-run.json. Replace 'D4/D1' with those in-repo anchors (`lint/checks/35-board-integrity.py` rules 4-6). Add a lint or grep probe that fails if the three predicates drift from check 35's constants.
